summary: Round-2 verification of the 6 reported fixes for the Twins Graduation photography app. Backend: full pytest suite (48 existing + 4 new round-2 tests) = 52/52 passed. Added /app/backend/tests/test_round2_fixes.py covering email-keyed brute-force lockout (exact 429 on 6th attempt via PUBLIC URL + owner login unaffected), photographer role scope (403 on /api/dashboard/stats, 200 on /api/bookings), and owner add-photo -> portal visibility (no _id leak). Frontend (Playwright, public URL): FIX1 photographer login lands on /admin/jadwal, /admin and /admin/notifikasi both redirect to /admin/jadwal with the schedule rendered (no blank page, 0 console errors). FIX3 at 390px stat-revenue (Rp 17.500.000) and stat-outstanding (Rp 32.000.000) fit inside the cards (scrollWidth==clientWidth, no child overflow, document scrollWidth 390). FIX4 client portal INV-2026-0008: drive-invalid-note fallback shown for a non-embeddable link (no iframe rendered), photo toggle -> counter 1/10, submit-confirm-dialog opens, Cancel aborts without submitting, OK submits (selection-submitted-note appears, submit button removed, state persists after reload). FIX5 nav testids unique: nav-bookings=1 on desktop and on mobile; mobile drawer adds nav-bookings-mobile=1 (no strict-mode duplicates). FIX6 nb-package is a shadcn Select with 4 packages from /api/public/packages and auto-fills nb-total (Paket Silver -> 2500000). Regression: owner dashboard loads with stats; booking detail payment add updated Terbayar Rp 0 -> Rp 250.000 and Sisa Rp 2.000.000 -> Rp 1.750.000 with toast. Test data cleaned via cleanup_test_data.py; INV-2026-0008 restored (photos=[], selection_submitted=false, drive_link='', editing_status=menunggu_seleksi).

minor.issue: Still no pagination (to_list(5000)); will degrade as data grows (carried over from round 1, low priority).

Lockout is now email-only, which fixes the ingress problem but allows an attacker to lock a real user out of their own account by spamming their email (account-lockout DoS). Consider combining email + X-Forwarded-For and/or a short backoff instead of a hard 15-min block.

design_issues.screen: Booking Baru dialog (/admin/bookings) & booking list filters
issues: Tanggal (nb-date) / Waktu (nb-time) and filter-date-from/to still use native browser date/time inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar used on the public form - inconsistent in dark mode (not part of round-2 fix list, still open)
Login success toast still overlaps the header user block for ~3s (carried over, cosmetic)

action_items: Optional: replace native date/time inputs in the admin Booking Baru dialog + list filters with shadcn calendar/time components for consistency.
Optional hardening: email-only lockout enables targeted account-lockout DoS; consider email+XFF composite key or progressive delay.
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 round-2 fixes verified in code and at runtime: App.js Protected() now computes a role-aware fallback (photographer -> /admin/jadwal), auth.py identifier = email, StatCard truncates/shrinks, ClientPortal uses AlertDialog + driveFolderId() guard with drive-invalid-note, Layout suffixes mobile nav testids, Bookings.jsx nb-package is a Select fed by /api/public/packages.
ops.py dashboard/finance/analytics still load whole collections into memory and aggregate in Python (to_list(50000)) - move to MongoDB aggregation pipelines (unchanged from round 1).
backend/.env still defines an unused CORS_ORIGINS key while server.py uses FRONTEND_URL - remove to avoid confusion.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_auth.py (stale docstring about IP-keying bug removed; public-ingress lockout test now passes)
